sql: select COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) as total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(gross_profit), 0) as gross_profit from "fact_order_items" where "workspace_id" = ? limit 1

select order_date as date, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) as revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as order_count from "fact_order_items" where "workspace_id" = ? group by "order_date" order by "order_date" asc

select c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, COALESCE(SUM(i.total_price), 0) as revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) as order_count from "fact_order_items" as "i" inner join "dim_categories" as "c" on "c"."id" = "i"."category_id" and "c"."workspace_id" = "i"."workspace_id" where "i"."workspace_id" = ? group by "c"."id", "c"."name" order by "revenue" desc

select r.id as region_id, r.name as region_name, r.code as region_code, COALESCE(SUM(i.total_price), 0) as revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) as order_count from "fact_order_items" as "i" inner join "dim_regions" as "r" on "r"."id" = "i"."region_id" and "r"."workspace_id" = "i"."workspace_id" where "i"."workspace_id" = ? group by "r"."id", "r"."name", "r"."code" order by "revenue" desc

select 
                COUNT(*) as total_items,
                COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_on_hand), 0) as total_on_hand,
                COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_reserved), 0) as total_reserved,
                COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_available), 0) as total_available,
                COALESCE(SUM(inv.inventory_value), 0) as total_value,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.health_status = 'critical' THEN 1 END) as critical_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.health_status = 'overstock' THEN 1 END) as overstock_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.health_status = 'out_of_stock' THEN 1 END) as out_of_stock_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.health_status = 'optimal' THEN 1 END) as optimal_count,
                AVG(CASE WHEN inv.days_of_stock IS NOT NULL AND inv.days_of_stock > 0 THEN inv.days_of_stock END) as avg_dos
             from (select 
            f.id,
            f.workspace_id,
            f.product_id,
            f.warehouse_id,
            f.quantity_on_hand,
            f.quantity_reserved,
            f.quantity_available,
            f.unit_cost,
            f.inventory_value,
            f.safety_stock,
            f.reorder_point,
            COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) as sales_velocity,
            CASE
                WHEN f.quantity_available <= 0 THEN 0.0
                WHEN COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) <= 0 THEN NULL
                ELSE ROUND(f.quantity_available / v.sales_velocity, 1)
            END as days_of_stock,
            CASE
                WHEN f.quantity_available <= 0 THEN 'out_of_stock'
                WHEN (COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) > 0 AND (f.quantity_available / v.sales_velocity) <= 7.0) OR f.quantity_available <= f.safety_stock THEN 'critical'
                WHEN (COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) > 0 AND (f.quantity_available / v.sales_velocity) > 60.0) OR (COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) <= 0 AND f.quantity_available > f.safety_stock * 3) THEN 'overstock'
                ELSE 'optimal'
            END as health_status
         from "fact_inventory_daily" as "f" left join (select "product_id", "warehouse_id", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) / 30.0, 2) as sales_velocity from "fact_order_items" where "workspace_id" = ? and "order_date" between ? and ? group by "product_id", "warehouse_id") as "v" on "v"."product_id" = "f"."product_id" and "v"."warehouse_id" = "f"."warehouse_id" inner join "dim_products" as "p" on "p"."id" = "f"."product_id" and "p"."workspace_id" = "f"."workspace_id" inner join "dim_categories" as "c" on "c"."id" = "p"."category_id" and "c"."workspace_id" = "f"."workspace_id" inner join "dim_warehouses" as "w" on "w"."id" = "f"."warehouse_id" and "w"."workspace_id" = "f"."workspace_id" where "f"."workspace_id" = ? and "f"."snapshot_date" = ?) as "inv" inner join "dim_products" as "p" on "p"."id" = "inv"."product_id" inner join "dim_categories" as "c" on "c"."id" = "p"."category_id" inner join "dim_warehouses" as "w" on "w"."id" = "inv"."warehouse_id" limit 1

select 
                w.id as warehouse_id,
                w.name as warehouse_name,
                w.code as warehouse_code,
                COALESCE(SUM(inv.quantity_available), 0) as total_quantity,
                COALESCE(SUM(inv.inventory_value), 0) as total_value,
                COUNT(inv.inventory_id) as items_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.health_status = 'critical' THEN 1 END) as critical_count,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN inv.health_status = 'overstock' THEN 1 END) as overstock_count
             from "dim_warehouses" as "w" left join (select 
                inv.id as inventory_id,
                inv.warehouse_id,
                inv.quantity_available,
                inv.inventory_value,
                inv.health_status
             from (select 
            f.id,
            f.workspace_id,
            f.product_id,
            f.warehouse_id,
            f.quantity_on_hand,
            f.quantity_reserved,
            f.quantity_available,
            f.unit_cost,
            f.inventory_value,
            f.safety_stock,
            f.reorder_point,
            COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) as sales_velocity,
            CASE
                WHEN f.quantity_available <= 0 THEN 0.0
                WHEN COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) <= 0 THEN NULL
                ELSE ROUND(f.quantity_available / v.sales_velocity, 1)
            END as days_of_stock,
            CASE
                WHEN f.quantity_available <= 0 THEN 'out_of_stock'
                WHEN (COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) > 0 AND (f.quantity_available / v.sales_velocity) <= 7.0) OR f.quantity_available <= f.safety_stock THEN 'critical'
                WHEN (COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) > 0 AND (f.quantity_available / v.sales_velocity) > 60.0) OR (COALESCE(v.sales_velocity, 0.0) <= 0 AND f.quantity_available > f.safety_stock * 3) THEN 'overstock'
                ELSE 'optimal'
            END as health_status
         from "fact_inventory_daily" as "f" left join (select "product_id", "warehouse_id", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) / 30.0, 2) as sales_velocity from "fact_order_items" where "workspace_id" = ? and "order_date" between ? and ? group by "product_id", "warehouse_id") as "v" on "v"."product_id" = "f"."product_id" and "v"."warehouse_id" = "f"."warehouse_id" inner join "dim_products" as "p" on "p"."id" = "f"."product_id" and "p"."workspace_id" = "f"."workspace_id" inner join "dim_categories" as "c" on "c"."id" = "p"."category_id" and "c"."workspace_id" = "f"."workspace_id" inner join "dim_warehouses" as "w" on "w"."id" = "f"."warehouse_id" and "w"."workspace_id" = "f"."workspace_id" where "f"."workspace_id" = ? and "f"."snapshot_date" = ?) as "inv" inner join "dim_products" as "p" on "p"."id" = "inv"."product_id" inner join "dim_categories" as "c" on "c"."id" = "p"."category_id" inner join "dim_warehouses" as "w" on "w"."id" = "inv"."warehouse_id") as "inv" on "inv"."warehouse_id" = "w"."id" where "w"."workspace_id" = ? group by "w"."id", "w"."name", "w"."code" order by "w"."name" asc

select 
                COUNT(*) as total_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as on_time_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'delayed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as delayed_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as partial_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.total_purchase_cost), 0) as total_spend,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.ordered_quantity), 0) as total_ordered_quantity,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.received_quantity), 0) as total_received_quantity,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.defect_quantity), 0) as total_defect_quantity,
                COALESCE(AVG(d.lead_time_days), 0) as avg_lead_time_days,
                COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN d.delay_days > 0 THEN d.delay_days ELSE NULL END), 0) as avg_delay_days
             from "fact_supplier_deliveries" as "d" where "d"."workspace_id" = ? limit 1

select 
                d.delivery_status,
                COUNT(*) as count,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.received_quantity), 0) as quantity
             from "fact_supplier_deliveries" as "d" where "d"."workspace_id" = ? group by "d"."delivery_status"

select 
                TO_CHAR(d.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') as period,
                COUNT(*) as deliveries_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as on_time_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.total_purchase_cost), 0) as total_spend,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.ordered_quantity), 0) as ordered_quantity,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.received_quantity), 0) as received_quantity,
                COALESCE(AVG(d.lead_time_days), 0) as avg_lead_time_days
             from "fact_supplier_deliveries" as "d" where "d"."workspace_id" = ? group by TO_CHAR(d.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') order by "period" asc

select 
                s.id as supplier_id,
                s.name as supplier_name,
                COUNT(*) as total_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as on_time_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'delayed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as delayed_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'partial' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as partial_deliveries,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.total_purchase_cost), 0) as total_spend,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.ordered_quantity), 0) as ordered_quantity,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.received_quantity), 0) as received_quantity,
                COALESCE(SUM(d.defect_quantity), 0) as defect_quantity,
                COALESCE(AVG(d.lead_time_days), 0) as avg_lead_time_days,
                COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN d.delay_days > 0 THEN d.delay_days ELSE NULL END), 0) as avg_delay_days
             from "fact_supplier_deliveries" as "d" inner join "dim_suppliers" as "s" on "s"."id" = "d"."supplier_id" where "d"."workspace_id" = ? group by "s"."id", "s"."name" order by "total_spend" desc limit 5
select "id", "name" from "dim_categories" where "workspace_id" = ? order by "name" asc
select "id", "name", "code" from "dim_regions" where "workspace_id" = ? order by "name" asc
select MIN(order_date) as min_date, MAX(order_date) as max_date from "fact_orders" where "workspace_id" = ? limit 1
